name: Kuiper.Portable.Int32.add_delta
type_display:
x: FStar.UInt32.t -> delta: FStar.UInt32.t
  -> fn
       requires Pulse.Lib.Core.emp
       returns x : FStar.UInt32.t
       ensures Pulse.Lib.Core.pure (x == FStar.UInt32.add_mod x delta)

name: Kuiper.Portable.Int32.add_one
type_display:
x: FStar.UInt32.t
  -> fn
       requires Pulse.Lib.Core.emp
       returns x : FStar.UInt32.t
       ensures Pulse.Lib.Core.pure (x == FStar.UInt32.add_mod x 1ul)

name: Kuiper.Portable.Int32.copy_add
type_display:
input: Kuiper.Ref.gpu_ref FStar.UInt32.t ->
    output: Kuiper.Ref.gpu_ref FStar.UInt32.t ->
    delta: FStar.UInt32.t
  -> fn
       requires input |-> 'x ** output |-> 'old
       ensures input |-> 'x ** output |-> FStar.UInt32.add_mod 'x delta

name: Kuiper.Portable.Int32.early_add_three

r: Kuiper.Ref.gpu_ref FStar.UInt32.t
